courses.title: Sleep Well
courses.description: An online course of ten bedtime meditations from Tony Samara, each opening with a short talk and followed by a guided practice. The lessons cover letting go of the day's distractions, kindness to oneself and settling into deep, peaceful rest.

left_out: Durma Bem (Portuguese) and Dobro spite (Croatian) versions of Sleep Well: the same course in other languages; only the English one added, to avoid near-duplicates.
Detox Body, Mind and Soul and Guide to a Healthier Way of Eating: no longer found in the site's sitemap on 12 Nov 2026.
Meditation for Living a Fulfilling Life (free PDF): its description says meditation can 'decrease blood pressure, control pain'; blood pressure is on the not-allowed list, so still out (borderline).
flags: Sleep Well's page text is built by script; description and two offer prices (€44.85 and €49.50 EUR) taken from the page's own structured data. Its blurb says the meditations 'assist your body's healing during the vital hours of sleep' (wellbeing language, no condition named); kept.
Meditation for Living a Fulfilling Life left out as borderline; a human may judge a passing 'decrease blood pressure' acceptable.
